annotations.title: Prepare a rikma for someone else

description: Prepare a rikma on 1lev1 for ANOTHER person - not the user you are talking to - and get two links to pass on to them: (1) `previewUrl` - the rich public rikma page showing products, missions, hours/rates, resources, values and share split (read-only, safe to share anywhere, and live-synced with behind-the-scenes edits), and (2) `manageUrl` - the behind-the-scenes studio where they can edit everything without logging in first (add/remove missions, products, resources and partners, adjust hours +/- and rates, preview the public page, and click to sign up or claim and create the rikma). Use this when a member markets 1lev1 and sets up a new customer's business, or helps another member get started. NEVER use it for the user themselves; for their own business, partnership or idea use proposeRikmaBlueprint. If it is not clear who the rikma is for, ask before calling. Pass that other person's name and email as the user gave them for this, and the intent and blueprint exactly as prepareSignup takes them (include detailed missions with hours & ratePerHour where relevant so they can tweak hours immediately). Direct `signupUrl` (no account yet) or `receiveUrl` (existing account) is also returned. Nothing is created until the recipient creates it, and the caller keeps no access once claimed. Refused when the email is the user's own. Valid 14 days. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#prepareForSomeoneElseTool

holder.description: me = the person importing does it; open = recruit someone; partner = link to a partner by partnerRef and invite them to contribute.

hours.description: Hours in total, or per month when recurring

partnerRef.description: Exact `ref` of the partner who will do this mission when holder is "partner".

email.description: Email address to send the rikma invitation to. Ask the person for it; never guess or invent it. If omitted, no email invitation can be sent.

holder.description: me = the person importing does it; open = recruit someone; partner = link to a partner by partnerRef and invite them to contribute.

kindOf.description: monthly / yearly = a running cost (rent, subscription); price is then per month / year

partnerRef.description: Exact `ref` of the partner who will provide this resource when holder is "partner".

price.description: Per month / year when kindOf is monthly / yearly, otherwise the whole price

email.description: The email the person gave you to sign up with - the confirmation goes there.

forSomeoneElse.description: Confirms the rikma is for another person, not the user you are talking to.

name.description: The name the person gave you to sign up with.
